title: ID0424289-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / P0 170001045] Charger Calibration
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
All of our Siemens charging stations have undergone calibration and contactors have been replaced because they were causing problems. All of these changes still need to be completed for this charging station, as it has been in storage for a long time and has only been in operation for a few months. We would appreciate feedback on the process.

Hallo Team Siemens,
es gibt hier auch keine aktuellen Störungen.
Alle unsere Siemens Ladesäulen wurden nachträglich von euch angefahren und das Eichrecht nachgerüstet und Schütze ausgetauscht, da diese Probleme machten.

Ich bitte um Kommunikation in Deutscher Landessprache.
